For this job as Data Scientist / Business Consultant Regulatory Management in IT RDM (Research, Development \& Medicine), we need your vision and your ability to turn complex data into meaningful action.


We are redefining how Regulatory Management uses data, from creating trusted insights, to orchestrating sustainable agentic architectures, to selecting the advanced AI technologies that genuinely move the business forward. You will help us by asking questions like: What business value can we unlock with this data? How do we best to augment our experts through a reliable cognitive layer? Which technology is the right tool for purpose \- and how do we successfully bring these complex systems into production? We are building new ways of handling our data, combining business consulting with hands\-on AI engineering, multi\-agent orchestration, and modern engineering practices.


Challenging? Definitely. Exciting? More than most jobs, we think.


This position is part time eligible with 80 %.

* You will develop strategies for data processing, insight generation, and agentic automation, choosing technologies that fit purpose and ensure long\-term organizational sustainability and help bring them to operational use.

* Several years of practical hands\-on experience in Python, preferably in data engineering or backend contexts
* Several years of professional experience in data analytics, algorithmic thinking, or modern AI approaches, ideally including agentic architecture or LLM\-based tooling.

description:
Hello! Thanks for stopping by. Let us tell you about all the great reasons to join our apprenticeship programme here at Yorkshire Water!

  



We have an exciting opportunity an **Apprentice Data Scientist** to join the **Central Control Team** at Yorkshire Water and be a part of helping Yorkshire Water to provide the best service to our customers. **Could this be you?**

  


**Salary \& Benefits**

  


* **Salary:** £24,309 per annum
* **Extras**: Annual incentive bonus, 25 days holiday \+bank holidays and wellness day
* **Pension**: Up to 12% Company contribution
* **Life Insuranc**e: 4 times pensionable salary
* **Work type:** Permanent: 37 hours per week, Monday – Friday.
* A great benefits package: choose from health cash plan scheme, critical illness insurance, dental insurance, life assurance flex and partner cover.
* Retail savings scheme
* Online GP service, cycle to work scheme, gym membership discounts and many more!

  


**Location: Hybrid\- this role involves a mixture of working from our Head Office and working from home. Please note currently our Head Office is based in Buttershaw, Bradford but moves to Leeds Valley Park Summer 2026\.**

  


**Program Support:**

  


* Carefully selected training providers to deliver the specialist knowledge related to your role
* A mentor who is an expert in your field to support you through your apprenticeship
* Access to the Funded Learning Team who provide specialist support to you throughout your apprenticeship journey
* Development opportunities in line with the apprenticeship progression plan along with additional extracurricular activities to enhance your employability skills and personal brand

  


**What we do:**

  



Everyone has an idea of what a water company does. Here in Yorkshire, we make sure that over 5\.4 million people living in the region and the millions of people who visit our region each year, can rely on our services, and have clean and safe drinking water on tap and that their wastewater is taken away. But for us, it’s so much more than this.

  



We look after communities, protect the environment, and plan to look after Yorkshire’s water, today, tomorrow 24/7, 365 days a year. We provide essential water and wastewater services to every corner of the Yorkshire region, and play a key role in the region’s health, wellbeing, and prosperity.

  



New environmental legislation, unprecedented levels of investment and changing expectations from customers means that this is an exciting time to discover opportunities within the water industry. Our People team are a key part of how we plan to meet the changing expectations of customers and regulators.

  


**Where you fit in:**

  



As a Data Scientist Apprentice working within Central Control you will spend time with a variety of Intelligence Analysts and Optimisation Specialists to monitor, analyse and present data to maintain the safety and optimisation of our sites and processes.

  



This will include building your competence in:

  


* Identifying poor performing wastewater assets through analysis of predictive performance indicators, historical data analysis and monitoring data.
* Making performance data available to stakeholders (e.g. River Health, Wastewater Operations, and external contractors and consultants)
* Liaison with compliance and policy teams to help develop and standardise procedure to ensure compliance to procedure and consistency of service to maximise success rate/incidents avoided.
* Engaging internal stakeholders within the organisation to communicate progress, performance and recommendations for improvement
* Scenario modelling/ forecasting, utilising new systems and technology to improve understanding of risks, building in site knowledge and root cause insights.
* Understanding our central systems and processes so that we can provide a centre of excellence with respect to alarm and SCADA management. To ensure we meet our compliance, pollution and optimisation targets.
* Working closely with Business Team Leaders and other business representatives to ensure that system configurations are optimised and data records are effectively maintained and where appropriate amended in a timely fashion.

  


**What you will study:**

  



As a **Data Science Apprentice** you will study **the level 6 Data Science Degree Apprenticeship** with specialist Tech training provider QA. The Apprenticeship is delivered virtually through live webinars, 1\-2\-1 coaching and on the job learning. The Data Scientist Standard supports Apprentices in their ability to work in a team to find ways to improve an organisation's processes. For further information, visit the link below:

  



https://skillsengland.education.gov.uk/apprenticeships/st0585\-v1\-1

  


**What skills \& qualifications you will need:**

  


* To hold 5 GCSEs or equivalent grade 4 and above/ A\-C including English, Mathematics \& a Science subject.
* To hold or be predicted 3 A\-levels or equivalent qualifications in any three subjects including an I.T. or a Business Studies related subject.
* A flexible approach to working including the ability to work within a 24/7, 365 days per year control facility (a requirement to work unsociable hours on a rota basis will be required towards the end of the Apprenticeship and once qualified).
* An ability to work in a fast paced environment demonstrating resilience and an ability to respond to changing situations.
* Effective communication, team working and interpersonal skills.

  


**Timescales to consider**

  



Adverts close 12th April 2026

  



Assessment Centres held on the 20th April with interviews to follow.

  


**Do we sound like your cup of tea?**

  



If you’ve got an interest in and want to learn more about out Apprenticeship programme and want to help us deliver great service for our customers whilst looking after the environment, then be sure to apply today to find out what a career with Yorkshire Water can offer you.

  



If successful for the role, you will be required to undergo pre\-employment checks that will include a Basic Disclosure Check, carried out through a Third\-Party Company, prior to commencing employment. Depending on the role, you may also be required to go through the security vetting process for either a Counter Terrorist Check or Security Check clearance.

  



All our roles are subject to a medical questionnaire, and further medicals when required.

  



We are proud to serve the Yorkshire region and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment that is reflective of the communities we serve. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds to apply.

As a **Senior Government Statistical Officer**, youll drive analytical work that informs some of the most important decisions in the country. Youll take responsibility for the full analytical lifecycle  from designing new data solutions, to quality assurance, through to communicating clear, influential insights to stakeholders.


Many roles involve managing teams of analysts and non‑analysts, supporting others to grow and championing the use of new tools, technologies and innovative analytical methods. Qualifications route

Experience route

description:
**AI Development Lead**

  


**Working hours: This role is available on a part\-time, job\-share or full\-time basis**

  


**Location: UK flexible/hybrid/home working**

  


**The opportunity:**  



Zurich is at an exciting point in its journey to embrace AI, and this role sits at the heart of driving our transformation. You will join our Global Life team, working to enable colleagues across the Zurich Group to get the most from AI, focusing on Life, Health, and Bank Distribution. You will work on cutting\-edge AI solutions at scale, collaborate with our newly\-formed AI Lab, and mentor colleagues in best\-practice and the art\-of\-the\-possible.



We are looking for an innovative, visionary, hands\-on AI expert who possesses the passion and experience to take a leading role on AI and ML at Zurich. Using machine learning and GenAI applications you will help improve business outcomes and drive innovation.



The ideal candidate is someone who is proficient in using AI/ML to solve business problems, and is also passionate about people, enjoying mentoring and supporting colleagues to do the same. You will focus on development of AI and ML solutions, while proactively supporting colleagues in delivering for our global business. A successful candidate will understand and explain the art\-of\-the\-possible, leveraging cutting\-edge techniques and knowing when to best apply them, while being comfortable with ambiguous problems and building solutions to them. You will enjoy this aspect, the process of solving a problem that colleagues may find it difficult to articulate, and will be someone who is happy working with stakeholders who may not share your technical expertise.



This is an excellent opportunity to take advantage of emerging AI trends to make a real\-world difference. To do this we are looking for an individual with a passion for innovative AI technology and who wants to work with teams of talented data scientists, engineers and consultants to design and develop the next generation of our data \& AI solutions. You will join a passionate and supportive company who are developing multiple high\-impact AI solutions, and will work with colleagues who share your enjoyment of all things AI.



Many of our employees work flexibly in a variety of different ways, including part\-time, flexible hours, job share, an element of working from home or compressed hours. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full\-time. Please talk to us at the interview about the flexibility you may need.

  


**What will you be doing?**  



You will take a key role in our digital transformation redefining the way we work, our solutions and enterprise platforms.  



As AI development lead, your main responsibilities will involve:
* Support colleagues across Zurich Life, Health, and Bank Distribution in becoming confident and self\-sufficient with AI to develop value\-driving use\-cases.
* Lead in prototyping ML/AI solutions while working with colleagues to make these ready for production, leveraging cloud tools and MLOps workflows using CI/CD and automated testing.
* Stay on top of current developments in AI/ML and assess their relevance to Zurich, including the potential ethical impacts, and help the team to stay informed.
* Understand company challenges and how integrating AI capabilities can help create solutions. Work to solve business problems using ML/AI, in situations where the requirements may be ambiguous.
* Collaborate with colleagues to identify and prioritize key areas of our business where AI solutions can drive significant business benefit
* Ensure high ethical standards are set and maintained when using ML/AI at Zurich.
* Provide technical guidance and inject advanced AI capabilities into projects in close collaboration with colleagues. Be a mentor to colleagues working on their own problems, proactively suggesting solutions
* Translate technology to business users, to motivate and excite them to use and apply AI technology. Act as an advocate for AI/ML in the business, communicating our work to stakeholders and emphasizing its business value
* Act as a thought\-leader on AI for Zurich and a point\-of\-contact for designing advanced AI/ML solutions, who colleagues will look to for support.

  


**What are we looking for?**  



Your skills and experience will ideally include:


* Experience in applying leading AI methods to practical and comprehensive technology solutions. Will have worked on end\-to\-end AI solutions in a commercial environment which have gone into production, with a focus on leading the development part of the process and supporting colleagues.
* Proven expert and thought leader in the area of machine learning and AI. Comfortable working with various data types including big data, text data and documents (e.g. XML, JSON).
* Experience working with LLMs to deliver value in a commercial organisation, including how to manage and monitor LLM\-based applications to maximise performance.
* Experience working with Microsoft Power Platform and CoPilot Studio
* Experience using Microsoft Azure cloud services and Python to prototype and deliver machine learning and AI solutions in a commercial environment, as part of an end\-to\-end solution, working within CI/CD and MLOps practices.
* Proficient in Python and modern software development practices within a team of developers e.g. use of Git.
* Passion for mentoring and supporting colleagues in AI/ML best\-practice.
* Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to articulate complex data \& AI issues and to gain the support from internal and external and executive stakeholders
* Strong analytical, structured and interdisciplinary way of thinking and working, including the ability to think creatively with data and being comfortable with complex and ambiguous problem\-solving
* Comfortable working in a business environment where stakeholders will not have all of the answers, understanding the need to be practical and to deliver for the business
* Ability to think proactively and ‘join the dots’ across a complex landscape to see the bigger picture.
* An understanding of the importance of team culture, and a demonstrable ability to act as a role model to maintain a culture of curiosity, support and honesty.


Nice to have:


* Knowledge of SQL and R
* Experience using Databricks and Spark with Python
* Experience with AWS cloud services to deliver machine learning solutions
* Experience in mentoring or teaching
